messages:
maya (PM): Kicking off Q3 OKR planning thread for quota & pricing roadmap. Need to decide: 1) tier caps vs soft overages, 2) rate-limit model (per-token vs rps), 3) SLA for Dedicated customers. Asking for quick takes by EOD Thu.

jonas (Pricing): TL;DR: favor soft overages for self-serve, hard caps for enterprise/Dedicated. Soft overages with alerting + grace credits. Keeps conversion path.

kevin (Finance): Agree on soft overages but we need clear revenue model. Proposal: 1) first 10% over = free grace, 2) next 40% = billed at 1.5x, 3) >50% requires manual uplift. Also want forecast tool for sales.

sana (Sales): Customers keep asking for burst credits and predictable monthly ceilings. If soft overages are too aggressive we'll see chargeback pushback. Can we add an optional "hard cap" toggle per account?

lee (Eng): Hard cap toggle is feasible. Implementation questions: per-token quotas are heavier (KV cache accounting) vs per-request/rps. Per-route limits also requested by Marketplace teams.

alex (DevEx): For self-serve UX, show projected bill + usage burn rate in console, and allow a single-click cap toggle. Also need API to pull quota state for infra.

jonas (Pricing): Suggested quota config example:
```
quota: {
  type: "tier",
  monthly_tokens: 1_000_000,
  soft_overage: { grace_percent: 10, rate: 1.5 },
  hard_cap_enabled: false
}
```
This maps to current SKU model and is easy to explain.

kevin (Finance): Looks fine. Need experiments to set grace percent: start 10% in beta then adjust. Also require alerts when usage hits 80% and 95%.

maya (PM): OKR tie: Q3 objective: "Reduce billing surprise for self-serve customers" Key results: 1) reduce >200% unexpected bills by 80%; 2) 90% of accounts have active cap or overage policy; 3) console shows projected bill for 95% of trips. Who owns experiments?

sana (Sales): I'll run a pilot with 10 high-churn self-serve accounts to test messaging and cap toggle acceptance.

lee (Eng): I'll scope effort. Rough estimate: backend quota engine + API (2 sprints), console + UX (1 sprint), alerts/integrations (1 sprint). Can we prioritize backend + alerts first?

jonas (Pricing): Prioritize backend + alerts, then console. Also need pricing docs and automated email flows for overages.

maya (PM): Sounds good. Trade-offs: per-token accurate billing vs faster per-request approximation. For Q3 MVP we do per-request for new customers, per-token for premium/Dedicated. We'll surface divergent estimates in console.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: quota-service-v0.1 will be deployed to staging tomorrow 03:00 UTC :party: 

alex (DevEx): One more ask: expose rate-limit headers for SDKs so developers can react to throttling. Low friction wins.

maya (PM): Action items:
- @lee: produce RFC with data model and rough effort by Mon
- @jonas: draft pricing rules + email flows by Tue
- @kevin: define billing tiers and grace revenue model by Wed
- @sana: list pilot accounts by Wed
- @alex: outline SDK header changes

Please react with :thumbsup: if aligned or comment blockers. Plan to lock sprint scope on Friday.

jonas (Pricing): :thumbsup:

lee (Eng): +1

sana (Sales): :thumbsup:

kevin (Finance): ok

alex (DevEx): :thumbsup:

maya (PM): Great — thanks everyone. I'll compile into the roadmap doc and add to OKR board.
